verdict.rationale: Ollama's own docs state that prompts are never tracked or trained on, and that nothing run locally ever leaves the machine. Running local models therefore keeps user data out of any training pipeline by default, which delivers the core of the story. Missing for 10: a detailed privacy policy or data-use terms covering the cloud offering, any explicit opt-out or retention controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the no-training claim.
